data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for generating Sanity CMS image URLs with color palettes and LQIP support.
data.what_it_does: Generates image URLs for Sanity CMS with crop and hotspot support. Parses image metadata such as color palettes and low-quality image placeholders (LQIP). Provides a placeholder widget for loading states.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app backed by Sanity CMS.
You need low-quality image previews (LQIP) while loading images.
You want to style your app using color palettes extracted from Sanity images.
avoid_when: You are not using Sanity CMS as your backend.
You need general-purpose local image caching or advanced image picking.
strengths: Native integration with Sanity CMS image features and asset pipelines.
Provides built-in color palette extraction and LQIP placeholder support.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to a single backend (Sanity CMS).
Limited to image URL generation and metadata parsing.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding flutter_sanity and flutter_sanity_image_url dependencies.
